name: Sautéed Gulf Shrimp and Grits
whyItWorks: Tender Gulf shrimp and creamy white hominy cheddar grits digest with very little mechanical friction when ordered without spicy Creole gravy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Tiana's Place, ask for the Creole sauce on the side (or plain butter/garlic shrimp over the cheddar grits) and hold the spicy andouille sausage slices if flaring.
watchOuts: Dairy cream in grits if lactose sensitive
